title: MSP: Modality Self-Play for Training Multimodal LLMs Without Paired Cross-Modal Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.20965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large multimodal models have achieved remarkable progress by scaling model capacity and training on massive paired multimodal data. However, this paradigm introduces a fundamental bottleneck: aligned multimodal datasets are expensive to curate, difficult to scale across diverse modality combinations, and increasingly constrain further progress. We introduce Modality Self-Play (MSP), a training framework for multimodal foundation models based on proxy-mediated modality composition. Instead of relying on paired cross-modal data, MSP uses anchor-supporting proxy textual descriptions of unseen modalities as semantic bridges during training. Given an observed modality (e.g., image or audio), the model generates proxy descriptions for complementary unseen modalities, which are then encoded and aligned with the observed modality through learned bridges, enabling cross-modal interaction without real paired non-text supervision. translated_title: MSP：无需配对跨模态数据的模态自博弈训练多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大型多模态模型通过扩展模型容量并在海量配对多模态数据上训练，取得了显著进展。然而，这种范式引入了一个根本性瓶颈：对齐的多模态数据集整理成本高昂，难以在各种模态组合之间扩展，并日益制约着该领域的进一步发展。我们提出了模态自博弈，这是一种基于代理中介的模态组合的多模态基础模型训练框架。MSP不依赖于配对的跨模态数据，而是在训练过程中使用未见模态的锚定支持式代理文本描述作为语义桥梁。给定一个观测到的模态（例如图像或音频），模型会为互补的未见模态生成代理描述，随后将这些描述编码并通过学习到的桥梁与观测模态对齐，从而在无需真实配对非文本监督的情况下实现跨模态交互。我们的核心假……
tldr: 本文提出模态自博弈（MSP）训练框架，通过让模型为未见模态生成代理文本描述作为语义桥梁，从而在无需配对跨模态数据的情况下实现多模态大语言模型的跨模态对齐与训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Modality Self-Play (MSP), a training framework that enables multimodal LLMs to learn cross-modal interaction without paired cross-modal data by generating proxy textual descriptions of unseen modalities as semantic bridges.
